newsitem.title: MEXICO: Clash leaves seven dead in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Clash leaves seven dead in Mexico.

text.p: A heavily armed group of civilians clashed with a unit of the Mexican military on Thursday, leaving seven people dead, newspapers reported on Friday.
Two soldiers and five of the civilians were killed in the battle in the state of Guerrero, newspaper Reforma reported.
The guerrilla group Popular Revolutionary Army (EPR) is known to operate in the southwestern state, but police said they believe the armed group was made up of drug traffickers.
